question: The ASA Physical Status classification and the Mallampati classification both assess the same clinical parameter — overall patient fitness for anaesthesia.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: These two classifications assess different things. ASA Physical Status describes overall systemic disease severity and operative risk; Mallampati classifies predicted ease of intubation by visualising the oropharynx with the mouth open and tongue protruded.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct — they are distinct. ASA PS classifies overall systemic health and operative risk (I–VI), whereas Mallampati scores predicted difficulty of laryngoscopy based on oropharyngeal anatomy (Class I–IV).
